cues: A thermostat maintains a steady room temperature, helping delicate houseplants thrive through seasonal changes.
Color-coded folders keep tax records organized, making important receipts easier to locate during filing season.
An acoustic panel absorbs echoes, allowing conference participants to hear each speaker more clearly.
Freshly sharpened kitchen knives slice ripe tomatoes cleanly, preserving their shape for a summer salad.
A well-tuned piano produces clear notes, enriching the melody during an evening concert.
